says: Opus supervises Sonnet and Haiku workers; Sonnet repairs in the same session

findings: src/sim.js resets cumulative shots to zero each round because s.shots never updates, violating the required game-wide count.
src/sim.js allows tanks to overlap after wall correction: with computer at (17.8,0) and player at (18.8,2.3), driving south for one second leaves their centres only 2.379 units apart.

src/shells.js falsely bounces shells near wall corners: firing east from (4.95,-11.2) registers a bounce after one step despite the shell remaining 0.283 units from the wall, beyond its 0.25 radius; reuse collide.js pushOut to detect actual circle contact.
The tests omit reverse driving, arrow controls, tank-to-tank collisions, inner-wall shell bounces and shells passing through each other.
The suite could not run because uv attempted to write its cache in the read-only environment, so its passing status remains unverified.
src/ai.js stops short of gaining line of sight: placing the player at (-18,-8) leaves the computer permanently stationary near (14.043,3.594), firing zero shots even after 330 seconds.

src/shells.js checks only step endpoints and misses grazing hits: with AI disabled, player at (0,0) heading 0 and computer at (3.225,1.449), a fired shell passes through the combined collision radius without causing damage.
src/input.js loses held controls when aliases overlap: holding W and ArrowUp then releasing W stops forward movement despite ArrowUp remaining held.

src/ai.js freezes the computer at valid position (10,-4,180) with the player at (-5,-10,0), because its expanded rectangular wall check rejects every waypoint, leaving it stationary without firing after 60 seconds.
src/shells.js checks wall collisions only at shell endpoints, so firing from (5.607,-9.9535,315) crosses an inner-wall corner during the first step without bouncing.
src/shells.js excludes exact tank contact with its strict distance comparison: firing from (0,0,0) past a computer at (3.225,1.45) leaves its health at 100 despite touching.
Nonblocking: src/sim.js place should reuse clearOfWalls instead of duplicating its wall-clearance check, keeping placement and AI validation consistent.
